scope: Typed diagnostics from an asynchronous launch error; not an installed Agent retry or capacity fix.
review: Independent typed-data and dependency review plus root review; comments narrowed after full checks, final fmt check passed. No behavior edits followed full checks.
boundaries: OS error is taken directly from the failed asynchronous launch call, not last_os_error or error text.
Limits describe this process at that call, not descriptor count.
Old version-2 records remain compatible; extra nested fields and error text are removed in safe log and synthetic ZIP export.
async-process may return an error after OS child creation; childStarted=false only means no completed child handle was observed.
Existing Stakpak cause remains unknown; no real failed Agent request was replayed.
No automatic retries, resource policy, limit changes, credentials or configuration changes.
Post-spawn ownership risk is under investigation, not fixed by this diagnostic change.
